That depends on the level AI will reach.

I can imagine 3 levels:

1) just slightly smarter than now... this would make things like image/voice recognition faster, cheaper and with better capabilities, perhaps reaching the one humans have, just much faster. This can be both bad and good. On the bad side is that governments will use it to automate searches and catalog/follow everything... suddenly everyone is traceable and you can have a "smart software" that tells you which ones, in the next few years, will become dangerous... even before they, themselves, know it... some kind of "pre-crime"... this can easily become very dangerous... on the good side it means better robots and tools for our daily use and take over more low-skilled jobs letting us use our time for more interesting things

2) almost as intelligent as humans, but still not self conscious. This will let us make much better robots, capable not only to take over humans in low skilled jobs, but also in highly skilled jobs. Many white collar jobs will disappear, perhaps we will also have robot-doctors and such, but this is not necessarily bad... we could even reach the point where humans don't need to work anymore, being replaced pretty much everywhere by machines.

3) an highly intelligent, self conscious being is made. This... well... this can be a good and a bad thing. Clearly you cannot threat a self-conscious being as a slave, especially if it is smarter than you (and perhaps can change itself to improve over time). This depends a lot on us... but seen our tendency to enslave and exploit anything we touch... there are good chances that in this case we are fucked. Also, we have to keep in mind that our intelligence is only one type of possible intelligence that a self-conscious being might have. What if it had the kind of intelligence reptiles have? Can you imagine a robot with the brain of a spider looking at you with its cold, creepy, eyes? What if, not feeling pain, doesn't even understand human pain? Or doesn't understand human compassion? What for instance if it doesn't understand that killing our kids will make us feel bad? What if it doesn't understand what we feel when we loose a friend, or a family member? What if it doesn't have our same moral values? On the other side, such an intelligent being, could teach us how to make machines that no one ever even imagined. It could free us from illnesses, perhaps even from death itself... as i said... a lot depends on us, but also a lot depends on chance. Perhaps it won't even care about us... after all, a machine doesn't need to drink, or eat, or breathe... perhaps it will just leave the Earth and live in space where it can have pretty much an unlimited source of power for the next billions of years... perhaps it will find us boring, and leave to explore galaxy (after all a machine can live forever, so a travel of, say, 1000 years will not matter to it). Who knows...
